moves.label: Trade: Hunter Tyson, Maxwell Lewis, Mojave King, Jalen Pickett, Julian Strawther and others
moves.description: A conditional 2029 1st round pick (DEN own) was acquired by the Oklahoma City Thunder in exchange for the draft rights to Hunter Tyson, a Least Favorable 2024 1st round pick and a Least Favorable 2024 2nd round pick. The draft rights to Maxwell Lewis was acquired by the Los Angeles Lakers in exchange for the draft rights to Mojave King and cash. The draft rights to Jalen Pickett, the draft rights to Julian Strawther, the draft rights to Hunter Tyson and a Least Favorable 2024 2nd round pick were acquired by the Denver Nuggets in exchange for the draft rights to Maxwell Lewis and a conditional 2029 1st round pick (DEN own). The draft rights to Mojave King, a Least Favorable 2024 1st round pick and cash were acquired by the Indiana Pacers in exchange for the draft rights to Jalen Pickett and the draft rights to Julian Strawther.

moves.description: K.J. Martin and a Swap 2026 2nd round picks were acquired by the Los Angeles Clippers in exchange for the draft rights to Vanja Marinkovic, a 2027 2nd round pick (MEM own) and a TPE. Josh Christopher, the draft rights to Vanja Marinkovic and a TPE were acquired by the Memphis Grizzlies in exchange for Dillon Brooks. Dillon Brooks, the draft rights to Alpha Kaba and a 2027 2nd round pick (MEM own) were acquired by the Houston Rockets in exchange for Josh Christopher, Usman Garuba, K.J. Martin, Patty Mills, TyTy Washington, Jr., a 2024 2nd round pick (HOU own), a 2025 2nd round pick (MIN own), a Swap 2026 2nd round picks, a 2028 2nd round pick (HOU own), a 2029 2nd round pick (HOU own) and a 2030 2nd round pick (HOU own). Patty Mills, a 2024 2nd round pick (HOU own), a 2029 2nd round pick (HOU own) and a 2030 2nd round pick (HOU own) were acquired by the Oklahoma City Thunder in exchange for cash. Usman Garuba, TyTy Washington, Jr., a 2025 2nd round pick (MIN own), a 2028 2nd round pick (HOU own) and cash were acquired by the Atlanta Hawks in exchange for the draft rights to Alpha Kaba and multiple TPEs.

moves.label: Trade: James Harden, Filip Petrusev, P.J. Tucker, Nicolas Batum, Robert Covington and others
moves.description: James Harden, Filip Petrusev and P.J. Tucker were acquired by the Los Angeles Clippers in exchange for Nicolas Batum, Robert Covington, K.J. Martin, Marcus Morris, a More Favorable 2024 2nd round pick, a Swap 2027 1st round picks, a 2028 1st round pick (LAC own), a Swap 2029 1st round picks, a 2029 2nd round pick (LAC own) and cash. A Swap 2027 1st round picks and cash were acquired by the Oklahoma City Thunder in exchange for a Least Favorable 2026 1st round pick. Nicolas Batum, Robert Covington, K.J. Martin, Marcus Morris, a More Favorable 2024 2nd round pick, a Least Favorable 2026 1st round pick, a 2028 1st round pick (LAC own), a Swap 2029 1st round picks, a 2029 2nd round pick (LAC own), cash and multiple TPEs were acquired by the Philadelphia Sixers in exchange for James Harden, Filip Petrusev, P.J. Tucker and a TPE.
